setGuide.label: Set bonuses
setGuide.subtitle: Each set asks for a number of pieces and grants a bonus.
setGuide.rule: Counting happens <perCard>card by card</perCard>: two pieces of a set on the same card count, split across two cards they don't. Each card has <slots>7 slots</slots>, enough to wear two sets at once — a 4 and a 3, or a 4 and a 2. Wearing more pieces than the set asks for brings <nothing>nothing extra</nothing>.
